Subject: Vendor portal access - account created but PO routing failing

Hi Karthik,

Thanks for getting our supplier account created in the portal this morning. Elena here from NovaParts — account username is elena@novaparts.com. We completed the onboarding checklist and uploaded our W-9 (attached).

When our first test PO arrived from Acme Distribution the portal rejected it with a mapping error: "missing buyerOrderNumber". The PO file we received looks like a standard Ariba/Coupa export (I can attach a sample if helpful).

Two asks:
- Can you share the exact PO field names Redwood expects (poNumber, buyerOrderNumber, orderId, etc.) so we can confirm what our buyer is sending?
- Is there a vendor-side checklist or sample PO we should use to validate before re-submitting?

We hit a hard stop on receiving POs which blocks invoicing; appreciate any quick guidance.

Attached: vendor_w9.pdf

Thanks,

Subject: Re: Vendor portal access - account created but PO routing failing

Elena — thanks for the heads up and attachment.

Short answer: we have a small field-name mismatch between some older buyer integrations and the portal import pipeline. I pulled together the vendor-side checklist and the PO mapping fields below — please have your buyer try one of the sample files (or send over your sample PO) and we can test it end-to-end.

Vendor onboarding checklist (vendor action items)
- Confirm company legal name + tax ID (we received your W-9)
- Provide a sample PO in the format your buyers send (CSV or JSON)
- Confirm remit-to address and invoice contact email
- If using EDI: send X12 850 sample

Expected PO fields (portal canonical names):
- poNumber (string)
- orderDate (YYYY-MM-DD)
- buyerName
- buyerTaxId (optional)
- lineItems[] with fields: sku, quantity, unitPrice
- currency

Common mismatch: some buyers send "buyerOrderNumber" instead of "poNumber" — our import pipeline should accept either but a small normalization bug is causing failures for certain feeds.

I’ve looped in Ben from Procurement Ops to provide a PO mapping example and next steps. If convenient, please attach one of the raw POs you received and I’ll coordinate a test.

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Procurement Manager | Redwood Inference
karhtik_iyer@redwood.ai
From: ben_carter@redwood.ai

Date: 2026-11-07T11:27:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Vendor portal access - account created but PO routing failing

FYI — digging in. Summary and quick workaround below.

What I found:
- The ingestion service that normalizes inbound PO fields has a loose mapping table. In most cases buyerOrderNumber has been mapped, but for older Ariba feeds the field arrives as "Order_Number" and our normalizer missed that key.
- There's also a validation step that rejects PO if poNumber is empty even if buyerOrderNumber exists. That's the failing path.

Temporary workarounds for NovaParts:
- Ask buyer/Acme Distribution to resend and include a top-level "poNumber" field (fast but requires buyer participation).
- Or, provide a small sample PO file to us and we will run a quick one-off transform to accept buyerOrderNumber as poNumber for their feed.

Attached is a small CSV that shows the canonical mapping we expect: po_field_mapping_example.csv. Ben from Ops has included a mapping row for the common variants.

Next steps (recommended):
1) Elena: please send one raw sample PO you received from Acme (CSV or JSON) — we will test.
2) Marissa: can you please add a temporary normalization rule on the import service for this vendor feed (map "buyerOrderNumber" and "Order_Number" -> "poNumber")? If ops needs an owner to approve the change, tag Eng.

Ben Carter
Procurement Ops | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai
